blocks.title: Commercial Engine
blocks.body: Andaz commercial distribution rides World of Hyatt direct channels, GDS, OTAs, and parent sales systems. Luxury lifestyle: local design authorship, social public space, and World of Hyatt distribution for travelers who want place-led luxury. Owners should underwrite channel mix and loyalty contribution for this asset—not corporate averages alone.

blocks.title: Commercial Differentiator
blocks.body: Versus Park Hyatt quiet residential luxury, Andaz sells lifestyle and local design; versus Hyatt Centric explorer lifestyle, Andaz sits higher on luxury intensity.

blocks.title: Channels
blocks.body: Brand.com / World of Hyatt app · major OTAs · GDS · metasearch (where active for the hotel)

blocks.title: Campaigns
blocks.body: World of Hyatt and parent portfolio campaigns where the hotel is eligible

blocks.title: B2B Programs
blocks.body: Corporate, SME, and RFP programs routed through parent sales infrastructure where active for this flag

blocks.title: Owner Lens
blocks.body: Model Andaz contribution after loyalty chargebacks, preferred-agency commissions, and local competitive set reality—not headline RevPAR alone.

blocks.title: Distribution & Channel Mix
blocks.body: Parent central reservations, World of Hyatt app, and designated online channels—confirm commission structures and rate parity obligations in the current agreement exhibit.

blocks.title: Revenue Management
blocks.body: Parent revenue tools and World of Hyatt demand signals support pricing experiments; owners still need property-level strategy for this brand's product promise.

blocks.title: Digital Marketing & Performance Media
blocks.body: Paid and owned media templates at portfolio scale, with creative that must still feel brand- and hotel-specific rather than generic parent advertising.

blocks.title: Corporate, SME & Group Pull
blocks.body: Contracted travelers, small meetings, and negotiated programs where Andaz fits the account's brand ladder.

blocks.title: Owner Perception Risk
blocks.body: Owners sometimes expect lifestyle lightness without systems cost; Andaz still carries parent systems, World of Hyatt economics, and brand QA. Align IC expectations early.

blocks.title: World of Hyatt
blocks.body: Andaz participates in World of Hyatt. Members earn and redeem points and receive Elite recognition across participating sister brands. Confirm current tier names and earn rules on the official program site before IC.

blocks.title: Loyalty
blocks.body: World of Hyatt at Andaz

blocks.title: Earn
blocks.body: Guests earn World of Hyatt points on qualifying stays at Andaz. Elite members may receive enhanced earn and recognition benefits per current program rules.

blocks.title: Redeem
blocks.body: Points redeem for stays across the World of Hyatt portfolio, including Andaz, subject to availability and current redemption charts.

blocks.title: Elite Recognition
blocks.body: Elite status recognition (upgrades, late checkout, lounge access where offered) applies per property capability—delivery varies by hotel.

blocks.title: Ecosystem
blocks.body: World of Hyatt partnerships, co-branded cards, and bonus campaigns expand the loyalty halo; Andaz stays remain the property-level earn/redeem node.

blocks.title: Owner Lens
blocks.body: World of Hyatt drives distribution and repeat demand but adds loyalty chargebacks and program economics. Underwrite net contribution after loyalty—not membership vanity metrics.

blocks.title: P&L Implications
blocks.body: Loyalty assessments and program contribution affect net rooms revenue. Use current agreement exhibits; do not invent undisclosed rates.

blocks.title: Operating Implications
blocks.body: Front desk and systems must support World of Hyatt enrollment, Elite recognition, and redemption stays without erasing the brand's guest experience.

blocks.title: Systems Implications
blocks.body: Parent property and reservation systems integration is required for World of Hyatt participation—budget cutover and training in the conversion plan.

blocks.title: Repeat Guest Capture
blocks.body: World of Hyatt earn and recognition support repeat Andaz stays when the hotel already delivers the brand promise—membership alone does not replace product fit.

blocks.title: Direct Channel & Member Pricing
blocks.body: World of Hyatt member rates and Hyatt direct paths help Andaz defend contribution versus high-commission intermediaries; confirm current rate rules before IC.

blocks.title: Elite Member Value
blocks.body: Elite recognition benefits support contribution at Andaz where the property can deliver upgrades and service standards; capability still varies by asset.

blocks.title: Cross-Brand Traveler Flow
blocks.body: World of Hyatt recognition across Hyatt sister brands matters for multi-brand itineraries—Andaz is the brand-specific earn/redeem node inside that network.

blocks.title: Partner & Payment Scale
blocks.body: World of Hyatt partnerships and bonus campaigns expand acquisition; underwrite hotel-level net contribution after loyalty assessments—not headline membership counts.

blocks.title: Corporate & Negotiated Demand
blocks.body: Hyatt account and negotiated transient patterns can support midweek compression where corporate mix fits Andaz—validate against this hotel's source markets.

blocks.title: To Join
blocks.body: Andaz application, royalty, program fees, and World of Hyatt assessments — confirm current Hyatt luxury lifestyle disclosure exhibits. Amounts are not staged without a verified disclosure.

blocks.title: To Operate
blocks.body: Steady-state royalty, program contribution, and World of Hyatt loyalty assessments — confirm definitions, bases, and current percentages in the live disclosure exhibit for Andaz. Do not underwrite from peer rumor.

blocks.title: When Things Change
blocks.body: Renewal PIP; conversion PIP revisions; transfer / change-of-ownership fees; termination-related obligations; owner-funded reserves—triggered at renewal, repositioning, or exit. Confirm liquidated damages and transfer mechanics in the current agreement.

blocks.title: Fee Variability
blocks.body: Initial vs conversion paths differ; program contribution and loyalty assessments may change by year under agreement terms. Lock the fee exhibit before IC—never extrapolate from a peer hotel's rumor. Geography note: Confirm current Hyatt development / franchise disclosure for Andaz (luxury lifestyle)

blocks.title: Why Value Is Strongest in These Scenarios
blocks.body:
Keep Local Product Intent—Add World of Hyatt: retain Andaz's brand promise while accessing loyalty earn/redeem and parent commercial systems a standalone hotel cannot buy alone.
Luxury lifestyle: local design authorship, social public space, and World of Hyatt distribution for travelers who want place-led luxury.
Sibling Clarity: diligence fit versus same-parent peers before assuming identical owner use case or fee path.
Operator & Owner Fit: strongest when the asset can deliver the brand's guest promise with QA discipline—weakest when sponsors want the flag without the product investment.
Disclosure Discipline: model economics only from current fee exhibits—Factory 2.0 does not invent undisclosed percentages.

blocks.title: Owner Operating Lens
blocks.body: Underwrite Andaz staffing, F&B intensity, and brand QA against this asset's segment—do not import peer-brand operating assumptions from a different ladder rung.

blocks.title: Systems & Brand Standards
blocks.body: Parent PMS/CRS, World of Hyatt enrollment, and brand QA audits apply. Budget conversion training and standards compliance in the PIP / opening plan.

blocks.body: Confirm current Andaz openings and pipeline by APAC, EMEA, CALA / LATAM, and North America from parent development disclosures—not stale media counts.

blocks.title: Owner Footprint Lens
blocks.body: Portfolio scale helps distribution; hotel-level contribution still depends on local competitive set, product delivery, and World of Hyatt mix for this asset.

blocks.title: Dealality Insight
blocks.body: Andaz creates value when design authorship and luxury delivery are both funded; fails when underwritten like select-service or anonymous upper-upscale.

blocks.title: Owner Takeaway
blocks.body: Use Andaz when the asset can deliver the brand promise and the fee exhibit clears IC—not because the parent portfolio is large.
